result.summary: Several layout and truncation problems are visible: restaurant names and cards are cut off, category chips overflow, and the bottom nav appears incomplete. These hurt scannability and polish on the home feed.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped by the right edge, so the name and image are incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels show partial next cards intentionally with proper padding, or fully contain cards within the viewport with consistent end spacing.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis or full-name affordance.
issues.suggestion: Use multi-line names, ellipsis truncation, or a tooltip/detail view so full names remain readable.

issues.description: Category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) overflow horizontally and the last chip is cut off with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with fade/peek of the next chip, or wrap/resize chips so all filters are discoverable.

issues.description: The pizza promo card at the bottom is heavily cropped; only part of the image and no restaurant name/details are visible in the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Adjust section spacing and card height so key content (image, title, meta) isn’t cut off above the tab bar.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar icons look uneven: Home is green/selected while others are low-contrast gray, and a thick center indicator/line sits under the search icon area.
issues.suggestion: Align tab icon strokes/sizes, clarify selected vs unselected states, and remove or refine the stray center bar so navigation looks intentional.

issues.description: Delivery time and fee text (e.g. €0.90 delivery) is light gray on white, which likely has weak contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast ratios for small UI copy.
